newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock to sell 30 Parc Royale units.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock to sell 30 Parc Royale units.

text.p: Wheelock & Co Ltd's property arm Wheelock Properties Ltd said on Friday it will sell 30 luxury residential units at its Parc Royale development in southern Shatin at an average price of HK$5,684 a square foot.
The new price compares with an average price of HK$5,000 per square foot during the previous sale of units last April.
The units are either 996 square feet or 1,600 square feet in size, Wheelock said in a statement.
Registration of potential buyers will take place from January 18-22, with official sales starting on January 25, it said.
